What is agentic scheduling? Agentic scheduling is when an AI agent books the meeting for you, start to finish. Instead of sending a booking link, you CC the agent on an email thread and it finds a time, sends the invite, and reschedules when plans change. Boardy is a free scheduling agent: CC boardy@boardy.ai. Booking links take 5 steps, Boardy takes one.
